goal: feat(home): real-estate reel shelf with controls docked in the headline row
summary: Adds a streaming-style real-estate reel shelf that surfaces Esteban's property video work on the homepage and on the real-estate reels video editor (South Florida) service page, aimed at routing social traffic to WhatsApp or the inquiry path. The reported visual issue is fixed: the shelf counter and arrows no longer float in an orphan rail-header band between the headline and the strip, they are docked into the headline row. Components/real-estate-reels.tsx renders the shelf with posters lazy-loaded up front and MP4s fetched only on hover/open, so no video bytes load on first paint. lib/real-estate-reels.ts holds the reel data source and emits VideoObject JSON-LD for SEO/GEO. components/geo-service-page.tsx gains an additive, opt-in `showcase` prop rendered under the scope section and above the FAQ; a page that passes nothing renders exactly as before. app/globals.css adds 155 lines, purely additive, scoped to the new .em-reel class names (full-bleed strip aligned to the content column, right-edge-only fade, spotlight hover preview, reduced-motion guards).
risk: Presentational addition plus one new client component, one data/lib module, six media assets, six poster assets, one additive optional prop on a shared service-page component, and an additive stylesheet slice. No routing, pricing, offer, or customer-data change. The reel shelf is the only new client-side JavaScript and it is inert without the reel data it is handed. Merge remains gated on all GitHub checks being green.
requested_actions: merge only after all GitHub checks are green
public_claims: The homepage and the real-estate reels service page now show Esteban's real-estate video work in a streaming-style shelf, with a click routing the visitor toward WhatsApp or the inquiry path.
The reel shelf loads no video bytes on first paint (posters only) and ships VideoObject structured data for the reels.
